workflows.title: Qwen-Image 2.1 Multi-Reference Edit
workflows.purpose: Combine two reference images into one
workflows.description: Combine two reference images into one

inputs.name: source_image
inputs.description: Media input: a data URI, an http(s) URL, or a gateway asset or video reference. The picture you want to change.
inputs.help: The picture you want to change.
inputs.label: a main picture

inputs.name: reference_image_2
inputs.description: Media input: a data URI, an http(s) URL, or a gateway asset or video reference. Another picture to take people, things or style from.
inputs.help: Another picture to take people, things or style from.
inputs.label: a second picture

form.prompt: A small teal fish mark on a clean white card.

example_request.curl:
curl '/v1/images/edits' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer '$AZIZAM_API_KEY \
  -F 'model=qwen-image-2.1-edit-multiref' \
  -F 'prompt=A small teal fish mark on a clean white card.' \
  -F 'extensions={"com.azizam.workflow":{"negative_prompt":"","reference_resolution":1024,"steps":25,"cfg":1.0,"seed":0}}' \
  -F 'image[]=@./source-image.png' \
  -F 'image[]=@./reference-image-2.png' \
  --output workflow-output.bin
example_request.python:
import os
from contextlib import ExitStack
import requests

with ExitStack() as stack:
    files = [
        ('image[]', stack.enter_context(open('./source-image.png', 'rb'))),
        ('image[]', stack.enter_context(open('./reference-image-2.png', 'rb'))),
    ]
    response = requests.request('POST', '/v1/images/edits',
        headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ.get('AZIZAM_API_KEY') or ''}"},
        data={'model': 'qwen-image-2.1-edit-multiref', 'prompt': 'A small teal fish mark on a clean white card.', 'extensions': '{"com.azizam.workflow":{"negative_prompt":"","reference_resolution":1024,"steps":25,"cfg":1.0,"seed":0}}'}, files=files, timeout=300)
response.raise_for_status()
open('workflow-output.bin', 'wb').write(response.content)
